plan.architecture: Modular JavaScript structure with a central game loop. Uses a WebGL library (e.g., Three.js) for rendering a 3D scene, DOM elements for overlay UI. Game entities (player, enemies, projectiles) leverage a lightweight object-oriented or Entity-Component-System (ECS) pattern. Dedicated modules for input handling, physics, audio, level management, and offline persistence.

art_prompts.background: Maze-like corridors of a futuristic base, constructed from chunky, low-poly voxel blocks. Industrial sci-fi theme with a palette of muted grays and steel blues, illuminated by harsh, angular fluorescent lights.
art_prompts.player: First-person view of a stylized, blocky voxel laser pistol. Visible muzzle with simple glowing particle effect capability. Minimalistic, robust design, held by a generic voxel hand.
art_prompts.enemy: A small, aggressive alien creature, entirely composed of low-poly voxels. Features a main body, stubby limbs, and a single prominent eye. Color scheme: dark greens and purples. Animations should be stiff and deliberate, reminiscent of early 3D games.
art_prompts.ui_button: Squared-off, pixel-art style button with a clear, bold retro font (e.g., 'START GAME', 'RESUME'). Simple contrasting color scheme (e.g., bright orange text on a dark blue button) with a subtle glowing edge effect for interactivity.

file_structure.index.html: Main entry point, loads game scripts and styles.
file_structure.game.js: Primary game logic, game loop, scene management, and module orchestration.
file_structure.style.css: Base styles for the HTML canvas, UI elements, and mobile responsiveness.

src/.renderer.js: Handles Three.js setup, scene creation, and rendering loop.
src/.player.js: Player character logic, movement, input mapping, weapon handling.
src/.enemy.js: Enemy AI, movement, attack patterns, health management.
src/.physics.js: Simple AABB/sphere collision detection and response.
src/.input.js: Manages touch controls (virtual joystick, buttons, screen drag).
src/.ui.js: Controls in-game HUD (health, ammo) and menu rendering/interaction.
src/.audio.js: Manages sound effects and music playback.
src/.level.js: Loads and manages level data, environment generation.
src/.persistence.js: Handles saving/loading game state using localStorage.

assets/.audio/: Contains sound effects and music files (.mp3).
assets/.ui/: Contains UI icons and button graphics (.png).

file_structure.dist/: Output directory for bundled and minified production build (generated by build tool like Parcel/Webpack).
